items.source: JPA 2.1 converters to turn JSR-310 types into legacy Dates. To activate these converters make sure your persistence provider detects them by including this class in the list of mapped classes. In Spring environments, you can simply register the package of this class (i.e. org.springframework.data.jpa.convert.threeten) as package to be scanned on e.g. the LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean.
items.translation: JPA 2.1 转换器用于将 JSR-310 类型转换为传统的 Date 对象。要激活这些转换器，请确保您的持久化提供者通过将此类包含在映射类列表中检测到它们。在 Spring 环境中，您可以简单地注册此类的包（即 org.springframework.data.jpa.convert.threeten）作为扫描包，例如在 LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean 中。
